== Summary ==
Original Players Committee Virtual slip: Blaster Rack (V), from the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Page 1, same position as on the 6 March sheet, slip 12 (no number printed on this sheet). Old pre-template slip (before the Players Committee remastered the set in December 2006). Cropped unchanged from a 300 dpi render of the PDF page (no retouching).

Source: https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf#page=1
